description: This PHP file defines a class 'ADODB_sqlite' that extends 'ADOConnection' to implement database abstraction layer functionality for SQLite databases, including connection management, transaction handling, metadata retrieval, and SQL execution. It also includes a class 'ADORecordset_sqlite' for handling result sets specific to SQLite.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlite
classes.description: Implements SQLite-specific database connection logic, including transaction management, metadata retrieval, and SQL functions.

classes.name: ADORecordset_sqlite
classes.description: Handles SQLite-specific result set operations, including fetching rows and fields.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the SQLite server version and encoding.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information about table columns using PRAGMA table_info.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL for formatting dates according to the specified format.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID using a simple sequence table.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table for generating IDs.
